A Combustion Belly Spiderling is a unique type of spiderling in the Iron Throne.

Involvement

These creatures are summoned by  Mizora in the Iron Throne if  Wyll is alive and chooses to rescue his father  Ulder Ravengard from there.

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Arachnid Jump ()

Jump up, down, and across. Your Strength affects how far you can jump.

 Range: 11 m (37 ft)
 Recharge: Per turn
 Bite ()
Damage: 5~11
1d4 + 3⁠Piercing
+ 1d4⁠Poison

Bite a target.

Deals 1d4Piercing damage and possibly deals an additional 1d4Poison damage.

 CON Save
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Spiderling Burst ()
Damage: 3~18
3d6⁠Fire
The spiderling explodes upon death.
 DEX Save

When killed or on their turn, Combustion Belly Spiderlings can explode using Spiderling Burst. A  DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw can be made to take half damage. While not of significantly high damage at this stage of the game, this usually causes other Combustion Belly Spiderlings to also explode, potentially killing Ulder Ravengard.
